signal: Prove launched its Identity Platform in April 2026 as the trust layer for an agentic world, expanding its agentic solution suite.

email.body1:
Weston, saw Prove launched its Identity Platform as the trust layer for the agentic world, with a new agentic solution suite alongside it.

A launch that big usually puts more growth accounts in play than the team can cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your growth number
email.body2:
Weston, quick follow-up for Prove.

Post-launch, growth targets usually move faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your growth team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Weston, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other identity vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Weston, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling growth coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a launch the calendar is its own kind of full, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a growth motion? I'll tailor it to Prove either way.
